quit.definition:
v put an end to a state or an activity
v give up or retire from a position
v go away or leave
v turn away from; give up
v give up in the face of defeat of lacking hope; admit defeat
quit.translation:
vi. 离开, 辞职, 停止
vt. 离开, 放弃, 使解除, 停止
n. 离开
[计] 结束, 退出

quit oneself of sth.translation: 解除, 免除, 消除

quit rent.translation: [法] 免役地租, 免役税

quit score with sb.translation: 和某人了清帐目,向某人报仇雪恨

quitch.definition:
n. Same as Quitch grass.
n. Figuratively: A vice; a taint; an evil.

quitclaim.definition:
n. document transferring title or right or claim to another
n. act of transferring a title or right or claim to another
quitclaim.translation:
n. 放弃权利
vt. 放弃权利

quitclaim deed.translation: [法] 产权转让契据, 放弃权利证书

quitclaimed.translation: v. 放弃合法权利( quitclaim的过去式和过去分词 )

quitclaiming.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Quitclaim
quitclaiming.translation: v. 放弃合法权利( quitclaim的现在分词 )

quite.definition:
r. to a degree (not used with a negative)
r. to the greatest extent; completely
r. of an unusually noticeable or exceptional or remarkable kind (not used with a negative)
r. actually or truly or to an extreme
quite.translation: adv. 相当, 完全, 十分

quite a little.translation: 许多, 很多, 相当多, 不少

quite the potato.translation: 恰如其分的例子,合适的事物

quitenidine.translation:
[化] 奎特尼定
[医] 奎替尼丁, 氧化奎尼丁

quiteron.translation: n. 奎特电子装置(使用超导材料的电子装置, 根据准粒子注入式隧道效应工作)

quiterons.translation: (quiteron 的复数) n. 奎特电子装置(使用超导材料的电子装置, 根据准粒子注入式隧道效应工作)

quito.translation: n. 基多（厄瓜多尔的首都）

quitrent.definition:
n. A rent reserved in grants of land, by the payment of
   which the tenant is quit from other service.
quitrent.translation:
n. 免役税
[经] 免役税

quits.definition: s. on equal terms by payment or requital
quits.translation: a. 抵消的, 对等的

quittance.definition: n. a document or receipt certifying release from an obligation or debt
quittance.translation:
n. 免除, 解除, 赦免, 赔偿
[经] (债务的)免除, 免除债务的证书, 收据

   bone.
